description: A composite figure laid out as a 4-row × 3-column table whose cells contain optical micrographs of low-density Fe-Mn-Al-C steels; the left column names the alloy class, the second column is "Hot rolled" and the third is "Cold rolled + Annealed". Row 1, Ferritic (δ) Fe-7Al [41]: (a) hot-rolled micrograph (scale bar 200 μm) shows fine elongated band-like δ-ferrite parallel to the rolling direction; (b) "CR+900 °C" (scale bar 50 μm) shows blocky dark-brown grains in a light matrix. Row 2, Ferrite based Duplex (δ+γ) Fe-3.5Mn-6Al-0.4C [48-50]: (c) hot-rolled (scale bar 25 μm) with arrows labelling "Ferrite Band" and "Secondary Phase Band"; (d) "CR + 880 °C" (scale bar 40 μm) with overlays labelling "Ferrite Band" and "Austenite Band". Row 3, Austenite based Duplex (δ+γ) Fe-18Mn-9.6Al-0.65C [65]: (e) hot-rolled (scale bar 20 μm, ND arrow) with δ and γ labels, black bands of δ stringers in γ; (f) "HR + 1000 °C" (scale bar 20 μm, ND arrow) with γ and δ labels, isolated δ islands in γ. Row 4, Austenitic (γ) Fe-29Mn-6Al-0.9C [20]: (g) hot-rolled (scale bar 50 μm) equiaxed austenite grains with twins; (h) "SHT 1050 °C/2h + 530 °C/60h" (scale bar 20 μm) coarser austenite with fine precipitates. The figure demonstrates that alloy class controls whether hot rolling produces banded ferrite, duplex banding or equiaxed austenite.

observations.observation: The group is a table of eight optical micrographs arranged by four alloy classes (rows) and two processing conditions (columns: 'Hot rolled', 'Cold rolled + Annealed').

Scale bars are printed in each micrograph and differ between panels: 200 μm (Fe-7Al hot rolled), 50 μm (Fe-7Al CR+900 °C), 25 μm (duplex Fe-3.5Mn-6Al-0.4C hot rolled), 40 μm (duplex Fe-3.5Mn-6Al-0.4C CR + 880 °C), 20 μm (the two Fe-18Mn-9.6Al-0.65C panels and the Fe-29Mn-6Al-0.9C SHT panel) and 50 μm (Fe-29Mn-6Al-0.9C hot rolled).
In panel (c) two arrows label 'Ferrite Band' and 'Secondary Phase Band' within the hot-rolled banded ferrite-based duplex microstructure.
In panel (d) the overlay labels read 'Ferrite Band' and 'Austenite Band', marking the two band types in the cold-rolled + annealed (CR + 880 °C) condition.
Panels (e) and (f) carry a 'ND' arrow and phase labels δ and γ; (e) shows continuous elongated δ bands in γ while (f) shows isolated δ islands after HR + 1000 °C.
Processing-condition annotations printed on the images are 'CR+900 °C', 'CR + 880 °C', 'HR + 1000 °C' and 'SHT 1050 °C/2h + 530 °C/60h'.

The caption's alloy labels are 'Ferritic (δ) Fe-7Al [41]', 'Ferrite based Duplex (δ+γ) Fe-3.5Mn-6Al-0.4C [48-50]', 'Austenite based Duplex (δ+γ) Fe-18Mn-9.6Al-0.65C [65]' and 'Austenitic (γ) Fe-29Mn-6Al-0.9C [20]'.

The citing text states that δ-ferrite in Fe-Al steels is elongated along the rolling direction and forms band-like structures because Al raises the recrystallization temperature of ferrite, as shown in Fig. 12.

The citing text states that in duplex alloys δ-ferrite stringers form parallel to the rolling direction while γ grains are refined by recrystallization, producing a banded ferrite/austenite microstructure, as shown in Fig. 12.
The citing text states that hot-rolled austenitic Fe-Mn-Al-C steels show an equiaxed austenitic grain structure containing annealing twins, as shown in Fig. 12.
The citing text states that coarse κ-carbides can form along original δ-ferrite grain boundaries on slow cooling and are semicoherent, thick, elongated rod-like in shape.
The citing text states that for a given Al content the austenite volume fraction and the thickness of austenitic bands increase with Mn and C content.

subfigures.description: Hot-rolled optical micrograph of Ferritic (δ) Fe-7Al; 200 μm scale bar; strongly elongated, lenticular band-like δ-ferrite aligned along the rolling direction in a light matrix.
Cold-rolled + annealed (CR+900 °C) optical micrograph of Fe-7Al; 50 μm scale bar; dark-brown blocky grains distributed in a light matrix.
Hot-rolled optical micrograph of Ferrite based Duplex (δ+γ) Fe-3.5Mn-6Al-0.4C; 25 μm scale bar; arrows label 'Ferrite Band' and 'Secondary Phase Band' in a banded microstructure.

Cold-rolled + annealed (CR + 880 °C) optical micrograph of Fe-3.5Mn-6Al-0.4C; 40 μm scale bar; overlay text boxes label 'Ferrite Band' (upper) and 'Austenite Band' (lower) within a speckled two-phase structure.
Hot-rolled optical micrograph of Austenite based Duplex (δ+γ) Fe-18Mn-9.6Al-0.65C; 20 μm scale bar with ND (normal direction) arrow; black elongated δ bands labelled δ within a γ matrix labelled γ.
Cold-rolled + annealed (HR + 1000 °C) optical micrograph of Fe-18Mn-9.6Al-0.65C; 20 μm scale bar with ND arrow; isolated δ islands labelled δ dispersed in a γ matrix labelled γ.
Hot-rolled optical micrograph of Austenitic (γ) Fe-29Mn-6Al-0.9C; 50 μm scale bar; equiaxed austenite grains with straight annealing-twin boundaries and a few small second-phase particles.
Cold-rolled + annealed sample (SHT 1050 °C/2h + 530 °C/60h) of Fe-29Mn-6Al-0.9C; 20 μm scale bar; coarse austenite grains with fine precipitates/decorated boundaries.
